name: Trade Query Criteria 14
definition: Query criteria on a trade transaction.

TradeLifeCycleHistory.name: Trade Life Cycle History
TradeLifeCycleHistory.definition: Field to define whether the query response file will include all reports submitted for a trade [true] or only the current state of the trade [false].||If false is selected, the reporting timestamp field cannot be used.||Usage: In case TradeLifeCycleHistory is not reported, the filter shall not be used to query the database of Trade Repository.

MarginLifeCycleHistory.name: Margin Life Cycle History
MarginLifeCycleHistory.definition: Field to define whether the query response file will include all reports submitted for a margin [true] or only the current state of the margin [false].||If false is selected, the reporting timestamp field cannot be used.||Usage: In case MarginLifeCycleHistory is not reported, the filter shall not be used to query the database of Trade Repository.

OutstandingTradeIndicator.name: Outstanding Trade Indicator
OutstandingTradeIndicator.definition: Field to define whether if the query response file will include all trades or only the outstanding trades.

FinancialInstrumentCriteria.name: Financial Instrument Criteria
FinancialInstrumentCriteria.definition: Indicates the query criteria related to financial instruments.

TimeCriteria.name: Time Criteria
TimeCriteria.definition: Query criteria related to time values.

OtherCriteria.name: Other Criteria
OtherCriteria.definition: Query criteria related to other fields.

TimeCriteriaReportingDateTimeRule.definition: If TradeLifeCycleHistory equals false, then TimeCriteria/ReportingDateTime must be absent.
